description: Core crypto engine + persistence layer + authentication (T04-T11): MasterKeyService (PBKDF2), CryptoEngine (AES-256-GCM + RSA/EC), Flyway schema migrations, all JPA entities and repositories, exception hierarchy, global error handler, TokenService (Argon2id via Bouncy Castle), and Spring Security token filter. Depends on FEAT-001 (project scaffold).
steps: Create Flyway migration g:\hsm\src\main\resources\db\migration\V1__create_hsm_config.sql: CREATE TABLE hsm_config (config_key VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, config_value TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW());

Create Flyway migration V2__create_hsm_users.sql: CREATE TABLE hsm_users (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), username VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, token_hash VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('ADMIN','CRYPTO_OFFICER','APP_CLIENT','AUDITOR')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE);

Create Flyway migration V3__create_hsm_keys.sql: CREATE TABLE hsm_keys (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, algorithm VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, key_state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (key_state IN ('ACTIVE','DISABLED','DESTROYED')), version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, wrapped_dek BYTEA, iv_dek BYTEA, auth_tag_dek BYTEA, key_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (key_type IN ('SYMMETRIC','ASYMMETRIC_PRIVATE','ASYMMETRIC_PUBLIC','ASYMMETRIC_PAIR')), public_key_bytes BYTEA, created_by UUID REFERENCES hsm_users(id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), last_rotated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, disabled_at TIMESTAMPTZ, destroyed_at TIMESTAMPTZ); CREATE INDEX idx_hsm_keys_state ON hsm_keys(key_state); CREATE INDEX idx_hsm_keys_name ON hsm_keys(name);

Create Flyway migration V4__create_hsm_key_acls.sql: CREATE TABLE hsm_key_acls (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), key_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES hsm_keys(id), principal_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES hsm_users(id), permission VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ALLOW', granted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), granted_by UUID REFERENCES hsm_users(id), UNIQUE (key_id, principal_id));

Create Flyway migration V5__create_hsm_audit_log.sql: CREATE TABLE hsm_audit_log (sequence_number BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, id UUID UNIQUE NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), principal_id UUID, action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, key_id UUID, outcome VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('SUCCESS','DENIED','ERROR')), chain_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_audit_recorded_at ON hsm_audit_log(recorded_at); CREATE INDEX idx_audit_principal_id ON hsm_audit_log(principal_id); CREATE INDEX idx_audit_sequence ON hsm_audit_log(sequence_number);

Create enums: g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\entity\KeyAlgorithm.java (AES_256, RSA_2048, EC_P256), KeyState.java (ACTIVE, DISABLED, DESTROYED), KeyType.java (SYMMETRIC, ASYMMETRIC_PAIR), UserRole.java (ADMIN, CRYPTO_OFFICER, APP_CLIENT, AUDITOR), AuditAction.java (USER_CREATE, USER_DISABLE, ROLE_ASSIGN, ROLE_REVOKE, KEY_GENERATE, KEY_ROTATE, KEY_DISABLE, KEY_ENABLE, KEY_DESTROY, ACL_GRANT, ACL_REVOKE, ENCRYPT, DECRYPT, SIGN, VERIFY, AUDIT_READ, AUDIT_VERIFY), AuditOutcome.java (SUCCESS, DENIED, ERROR).
Create JPA entity g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\entity\HsmConfig.java: @Entity @Table("hsm_config") with fields configKey (@Id), configValue, createdAt.

Create JPA entity HsmUser.java: @Entity @Table("hsm_users") with id (UUID @GeneratedValue), username, tokenHash, role (@Enumerated STRING UserRole), createdAt, enabled. Override toString() to EXCLUDE tokenHash.

Create JPA entity HsmKey.java: @Entity @Table("hsm_keys") with id, name, algorithm (@Enumerated STRING KeyAlgorithm), keyState (@Enumerated STRING KeyState), version, wrappedDek (@Column(columnDefinition="bytea")), ivDek (@Column(columnDefinition="bytea")), authTagDek (@Column(columnDefinition="bytea")), publicKeyBytes (@Column(columnDefinition="bytea") nullable), keyType (@Enumerated STRING KeyType), createdBy (@ManyToOne @JoinColumn optional), createdAt, lastRotatedAt, disabledAt, destroyedAt. Override toString() to EXCLUDE wrappedDek, ivDek, authTagDek, publicKeyBytes.

Create JPA entity HsmKeyAcl.java: @Entity @Table("hsm_key_acls") with id, key (@ManyToOne HsmKey), principal (@ManyToOne HsmUser), permission (String, default 'ALLOW'), grantedAt, grantedBy (UUID nullable).

Create JPA entity AuditRecord.java: @Entity @Table("hsm_audit_log") with sequenceNumber (@Id @GeneratedValue SEQUENCE), id (UUID), recordedAt (Instant nanosecond precision), principalId (UUID nullable), action (@Enumerated STRING AuditAction), keyId (UUID nullable), outcome (@Enumerated STRING AuditOutcome), chainHash (String 64 chars).

Create repository interfaces in g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\repository\: HsmConfigRepository extends JpaRepository<HsmConfig, String>. HsmUserRepository extends JpaRepository<HsmUser, UUID> with findByUsername(String) Optional<HsmUser>. HsmKeyRepository extends JpaRepository<HsmKey, UUID> with findByName(String) Optional<HsmKey>, findByKeyState(KeyState) List<HsmKey>. HsmKeyAclRepository extends JpaRepository<HsmKeyAcl, UUID> with @Query JPQL: findByKeyIdAndPrincipalId(UUID keyId, UUID principalId) Optional<HsmKeyAcl>, findByPrincipalId(UUID principalId) List<HsmKeyAcl>. AuditRecordRepository extends JpaRepository<AuditRecord, Long> with findTopByOrderBySequenceNumberDesc() Optional<AuditRecord>, findByRecordedAtBetween(Instant from, Instant to, Pageable) Page<AuditRecord>, findAllByOrderBySequenceNumberAsc() List<AuditRecord>.

Create exception hierarchy in g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\exception\: HsmException.java (abstract, extends RuntimeException, message must NEVER contain key bytes — enforce via constructor that strips any byte[] from message). AuthenticationException.java, AccessDeniedException.java, KeyNotFoundException.java, KeyAlreadyExistsException.java, InvalidKeyStateException.java, CryptographicOperationException.java, HsmInternalException.java — all extend HsmException.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\ErrorResponse.java: record with timestamp (Instant), status (int), error (String), message (String), path (String).

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\exception\GlobalExceptionHandler.java: @RestControllerAdvice. Map each exception subclass to HTTP status + ErrorResponse. Key rules: AuthenticationException → 401, AccessDeniedException → 403, KeyNotFoundException → 404, KeyAlreadyExistsException → 409, InvalidKeyStateException → 422, CryptographicOperationException → 400, HsmInternalException → 500. For destroyed keys also throw InvalidKeyStateException with distinct message but HTTP 410 for the specific destroy-check; alternatively use a DestroyedKeyException extends InvalidKeyStateException → 410. Spring's AccessDeniedException (org.springframework.security) → 403. NEVER serialize stack traces in response body.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\crypto\WrappedKey.java: record/class with byte[] wrappedDek, byte[] iv, byte[] authTag.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\crypto\EncryptionResult.java: record with byte[] iv, byte[] ciphertext, byte[] authTag.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\crypto\MasterKeyService.java: @Component @Slf4j. @Value("${hsm.master-key.iterations:310000}") int iterations. @Value("${hsm.master-key.salt-length:16}") int saltLength. Inject HsmConfigRepository. @PostConstruct init(): 1) Read HSM_MASTER_PASSPHRASE from System.getenv(); throw HsmInternalException('Master passphrase not configured') if null/blank — do NOT log the passphrase value. 2) Fail fast if iterations < 310000. 3) Load or generate 16-byte salt stored in hsm_config with key='master_key_salt' (Base64 encoded). 4) Derive SecretKey: SecretKeyFactory('PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256'), PBEKeySpec(passphrase.toCharArray(), salt, iterations, 256), SecretKeySpec(derived,'AES'). 5) Zero passphrase char array. wrapKey(byte[] rawKeyBytes): use AES/GCM/NoPadding, SecureRandom 12-byte IV, GCM 128-bit tag; return WrappedKey(wrappedDek, iv, authTag). unwrapKey(WrappedKey): AES/GCM/NoPadding decrypt; throw CryptographicOperationException on AEADBadTagException; zero wrappedDek array in finally. NEVER log masterKey or rawKeyBytes.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\crypto\CryptoEngine.java: @Component, stateless. generateSymmetricKey(): KeyGenerator('AES') 256 bits, SecureRandom; return byte[32]. generateAsymmetricKeyPair(KeyAlgorithm alg): KeyPairGenerator; for RSA_2048 use RSA/2048; for EC_P256 use EC/P-256 curve; return KeyPair. encrypt(byte[] rawKey, byte[] plaintext): Cipher('AES/GCM/NoPadding'), SecureRandom 12-byte IV, GCMParameterSpec(128,iv), init ENCRYPT_MODE with SecretKeySpec(rawKey,'AES'); doFinal; zero rawKey in finally; return EncryptionResult(iv, ciphertext, authTag — GCM appends tag to ciphertext, split last 16 bytes as authTag). decrypt(byte[] rawKey, byte[] iv, byte[] ciphertext, byte[] authTag): reassemble ciphertext+authTag, Cipher('AES/GCM/NoPadding'), GCMParameterSpec(128,iv), init DECRYPT_MODE; on AEADBadTagException throw CryptographicOperationException; zero rawKey in finally; return plaintext. sign(byte[] privateKeyBytes, byte[] data, KeyAlgorithm alg): rebuild PrivateKey from PKCS8EncodedKeySpec; Signature instance: RSA_2048→'SHA256withRSA', EC_P256→'SHA256withECDSA'; sign(data); return signature bytes. verify(byte[] publicKeyBytes, byte[] data, byte[] signature, KeyAlgorithm alg): rebuild PublicKey from X509EncodedKeySpec; Signature.verify; catch SignatureException → return false (non-throwing). serializePublicKey(PublicKey): key.getEncoded() (X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo). serializePrivateKey(PrivateKey): key.getEncoded() (PKCS#8). NEVER custom crypto. NEVER use Bouncy Castle here.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\TokenService.java: @Component. Inject BouncyCastle Argon2 (org.bouncycastle.crypto.generators.Argon2BytesGenerator + org.bouncycastle.crypto.params.Argon2Parameters). generateToken(): 'hsm_tk_' + Base64URL(SecureRandom 32 bytes). hashToken(String token): Argon2id, memory=65536, iterations=3, parallelism=4, salt=SecureRandom 16 bytes, output=32 bytes; encode as '$argon2id$...' string (or store salt+hash concatenated as hex — choose a consistent format). verifyToken(String plainToken, String storedHash): extract salt from stored hash, re-derive, compare using MessageDigest.isEqual (constant-time) or Arrays.equals on fixed-length hashes. NEVER log plain tokens. NOTE: Bouncy Castle is ONLY used in this class.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\security\HsmPrincipal.java: record/class with UUID id, String username, UserRole role. Implements UserDetails or is wrapped by UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\security\TokenAuthenticationFilter.java: extends OncePerRequestFilter. Extract 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header; if missing set anonymous context and continue (SecurityConfig denies non-authenticated paths). Resolve: call HsmUserRepository to find all enabled users (or better: store a fast lookup — see note). For each candidate, call TokenService.verifyToken; if match found, build UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(HsmPrincipal, null, List.of(new SimpleGrantedAuthority('ROLE_'+user.getRole()))). On any failure, call response.sendError(401) with a GENERIC message 'Authentication required' — identical for bad token AND unknown user (no oracle). IMPORTANT: to avoid iterating all users for each request, add a secondary index lookup: HsmUserRepository.findAllEnabled() — but Argon2 verification is slow, so in practice the filter should be designed to fail fast: try up to 1 attempt per request (caller provides token, no enumeration). Better approach: store a fast lookup key derived from the token prefix (first 8 chars) as a non-secret index in hsm_users — add column token_prefix VARCHAR(8), index on it; filter fetches by prefix, verifies hash of match. Add column token_prefix VARCHAR(16) to V2 migration or add V6__add_token_prefix.sql.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\config\SecurityConfig.java: @Configuration @EnableMethodSecurity. @Bean SecurityFilterChain: disable CSRF (stateless); sessionManagement(STATELESS); addFilterBefore(tokenAuthenticationFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class); authorizeHttpRequests: permit GET /v3/api-docs/**, GET /swagger-ui/**, GET /swagger-ui.html, GET /actuator/health; all others requireAuthentication(). @Bean ExceptionTranslationFilter customization: on AuthenticationException → 401 generic JSON (no WWW-Authenticate oracle). Disable formLogin, httpBasic.
